channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Walker Kessler | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Walker Kessler from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Austin Reaves on Matisse Thybulle, Ziaire Williams, Walker Kessler, Adou Thiero
item.description:
Lakers guard Austin Reaves on Wednesday:

“Trying to score on Matisse (Thybulle) and Ziaire (Williams), especially with Adou (Thiero) out there too, and then Walker (Kessler) on the back line is not easy.“I had to deal with that all day yesterday and today, and it's not fun.”

Austin Reaves on Matisse Thybulle, Ziaire Williams, Walker Kessler, Adou Thiero, Sep 30, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Walker Kessler
item.description:
Pelinka:

“Walker Kessler makes Luka better. He makes Austin better and vice versa. So it's just the perfect fit. And, we didn't see any opportunity like that coming down the pike anytime soon.”

Rob Pelinka on Walker Kessler, Sep 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Robert Horry on Walker Kessler
item.description:
Robert Horry, who helped win three of the Lakers’ five titles in the 2000’s said he believes top free-agent acquisition Walker Kessler will be the difference-maker this season.

“When you watch what Walker Kessler brings to the game, he’s so incredibly skilled and we haven’t had a big since AD that can block shots like that, pop out for threes,”

Robert Horry on Walker Kessler, Sep 7, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Quentin Grimes on Walker Kessler
item.description:
Grimes said on 710 AM ESPN L.A. with Mason & Ireland.

“He’s one of the best scorers in the NBA, probably. Walker (Kessler), you know, is one of the best rim protectors. I know he only played like four or five games last year, but everybody knows what he does. Nobody wants to go in that paint, 7’2”

Quentin Grimes on Walker Kessler, Jul 28, 2026. Source: Lakers Nation.

item.title: Austin Reaves on Walker Kessler
item.description:
Austin Reaves on the Lakers' addition of Walker Kessler, who Austin was teammates with during the 2023 World Cup:

“He’s a big, goofy dude that just enjoys life and has fun. Obviously you see what he does basketball wise and how he impacts the game. He’s good defensively, good in the pocket. Just a smart player. So I’m happy to have him on the team and get to play with him.”

Austin Reaves on Walker Kessler, Jul 13, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Walker Kessler
item.description:
Jaylen Brown:

“Kessler to the Lakers. Walker, you know, Georgia kid, played with Game Elite. I know he's excited about, you know, he's been in Utah. I don't know how he feels about the big lights, the bright lights in LA, because I know Walker is more of a, he like a chill, cool.”

Jaylen Brown on Walker Kessler, Jul 3, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mike Conley on Walker Kessler
item.description:
Mike Conley on Walker Kessler:

“Walker is a shining star for us right now, and one I don’t think a lot of people expect to come in and have an impact as early as he’s having an impact.”

Mike Conley on Walker Kessler, Jan 16, 2023. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: Will Hardy on Walker Kessler
item.description:
Hardy:

“Walker was sensational and he did so many good things for us. Something that will go unnoticed is Minnesota blitzed or had their big up in pick and roll for a majority of the game. Walker did a fantastic job of getting into the pocket and making great decisions for us.”

Will Hardy on Walker Kessler, Jan 16, 2023. Source: Twitter @millerjryan.

item.title: Justin Zanik on Walker Kessler
item.description:
Justin Zanik on Walker Kessler:

“We're excited about Walker Kessler,he’s a first round pick and a center who put up some really good numbers, both offensively and defensively for a top program in Auburn.”

Justin Zanik on Walker Kessler, Jul 9, 2022. Source: Twitter @BensHoops.
